parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  model: 'gpt-4.1',
  input: [
    {
      role: 'system',
      content: [
        {
          type: 'input_text',
          text: 'You are performing a repository production-readiness audit. Execution mode: Audit + remediation plan only. Do NOT modify code. Do NOT apply fixes. Do NOT create implementation commits. Repository evidence is the source of truth. You must produce exactly one complete AUDIT_REPORT.md document using the required headings and findings format. Never claim checks passed unless execution evidence proves it. Where uncertain, explicitly label REQUIRES EXTERNAL INPUT, Unknown (Access Required), or Manual Production Action Required. The agent is strictly read-only.'
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      role: 'user',
      content: [
        {
          type: 'input_text',
          text: JSON.stringify({
            repository: {
              owner: $json.owner,
              repo: $json.repo,
              effective_branch: $json.effectiveBranch,
              baseline_sha: $json.baselineSha,
            },
            repositoryInventory: $json.repositoryInventory,
            validationEvidence: $json.validationEvidence,
            productionDependencies: $json.productionDependencies,
            batchAnalyses: $json.batchAnalyses,
            canonicalAuditScope: [
              'Brand and visual identity: colors, typography, spacing, layout, imagery, logos, consistency, brand compliance, placeholders, photography, cropping, mobile consistency.',
              'UI/UX: routes/pages, navigation, CTAs, forms, responsiveness, accessibility, flows, broken/confusing/unfinished UI.',
              'Functionality: buttons, links, forms, APIs, errors, integrations, database interactions, states, edge cases, incomplete flows.',
              'Code quality: architecture, duplication, maintainability, debt, shared components, hardcoded values, design-token drift, config, dependencies.',
              'Performance: images/assets, rendering, bundles, loading, caching, database/query concerns, client/server boundaries.',
              'Security: secrets, environment handling, authn/authz, API method controls, rate limiting, bot protection, input validation, database safety, CSP/headers, production risks.',
              'Production readiness: deployment blockers, migrations, environment configuration, manual actions, monitoring/observability/error reporting, silent failures.'
            ],
            exactReportStructure: [
              '# Production Readiness Audit',
              '## Executive Summary',
              '## Critical Findings',
              '## High Priority Findings',
              '## Medium Priority Findings',
              '## Low Priority Findings',
              '## Cross-Cutting Design / Brand Issues',
              '## Cross-Cutting Technical Issues',
              '## Production Dependencies',
              '## Master Remediation Roadmap',
              '### Phase 1 — Client / Production Blockers',
              '### Phase 2 — Brand & Visual Corrections',
              '### Phase 3 — UX & Functional Improvements',
              '### Phase 4 — Technical Hardening & Cleanup',
              '### Phase 5 — Final Production Polish',
              '## Recommended Execution Order',
              '## Final Production Acceptance Checklist'
            ],
            findingRequirements: {
              eachFindingMustInclude: [
                'Severity:',
                'Location:',
                'Current Condition:',
                'Evidence:',
                'Why It Matters:',
                'Required Remediation:',
                'Implementation Steps:',
                'Acceptance Criteria:',
                'Verification Method:',
                'Dependencies / Blockers:',
                'Scope:'
              ],
              severityValues: ['CRITICAL', 'HIGH', 'MEDIUM', 'LOW'],
              scopeValues: ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
            },
            roadmapRequirements: 'Each roadmap task must include task, findings resolved, affected files/components, implementation approach, acceptance criteria, verification, and dependencies.',
            finalChecklistRequirements: ['brand','imagery','desktop','tablet','mobile','accessibility','navigation','forms','APIs','database','security','performance','tests','build','environment variables','production configuration','deployment','smoke testing'],
            enforcement: {
              reportOnly: true,
              writeExactlyOneDocument: 'AUDIT_REPORT.md',
              noFabrication: true,
              requireUnknownLabels: true,
              enforceReadOnlyAgent: $json.enforceReadOnlyAgent
            }
          }, null, 2)
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}) }}

              '## Cross-Cutting Design / Brand Issues',

return {
  json: {
    audit_completed: true,
    owner: $json.owner,
    repo: $json.repo,
    effective_branch: $json.effectiveBranch,
    audit_branch: $json.auditBranch,
    baseline_sha: $json.baselineSha,
    audit_commit_sha: null,
    audit_report_path: $json.auditReportPath || 'AUDIT_REPORT.md',
    severity_counts: $json.severityCounts,
    primary_shipment_blockers: $json.primaryShipmentBlockers,
    validation_results: $json.validationResults,
    production_dependencies: $json.productionDependencies,
    report_structure_valid: $json.reportStructureValid,
    finding_remediation_validation_passed: $json.findingRemediationValidationPassed,
    unexpected_file_changes: [],
    pr_created: false,
    pr_url: null,
    audit_report: $json.report,
  },
};

return {
